caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This vertical bar chart, titled "Fluency," illustrates the performance scores of four different prompts. The horizontal category axis displays the labels V1, V2, V3, and V4 in sequential alphanumeric order without an overarching axis title. The vertical value axis represents the score on the GEMBA-SQM, utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 97.0 to 100.0 with numeric tick labels and dashed horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.5. The chart consists of four individually colored bars, each corresponding to a prompt and visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. The highest value is represented by the V1 bar, which is blue and has a score of 99.15. The V2 bar is orange and indicates a score of 98.2, while the V3 bar is green with a score of 98.5. The shortest bar is V4, which is purple and displays the lowest score of 97.7. The bars are not sorted by magnitude but instead follow the alphanumeric sequence of their category labels.
